info.title: DocumentStorage API V1
info.description:
The API to store documents digitally.

# Main Concepts

The **Document Storage** service allows storing documents digitally.

Each document, depending on its document type, can also be archived.

`⚠️ WARNING: a document that requires archiving, once archived, can no longer be deleted!`

# Data Flow Diagram

For each LeviaHub customer code (Gamma customer code retrieved by AH through the ProductInstance / ApiKey), a dedicated document archive (Partnership) is created to ensure a clear separation of content.

![1.00](https://leviagroup.sharepoint.com/sites/DevTools/Documenti%20condivisi/ActiveHub/Schemi/flussodocumentale.png)

# Document Environment (Partnership)

When the various endpoints are called, the following operations are implicitly triggered:

1. **Creation / Retrieval of the document archive (partner)**\
   This is done based on the Gamma customer code obtained from the `ProductInstance` ([see data flow diagram](/api-docs?api=ah-documentstorage#description/schema-flusso-dati)).\
   Consequently, callbacks in **One\OTPSign** are also created to allow webhooks during the signing process (OTP method confirmation and completion of individual signing procedures).
2. **Creation / Retrieval of the company for which the document is being uploaded**\
   In this case, we are referring to the VAT number (not necessarily a LeviaHub customer) for which the product is attempting to store the document. The information to identify the company is taken from the `Company` property passed in the request BODY.
3. **Activation of DigitalHub services** `Partnership`, `One\DMS`, **and** `One\OTPSign`.
4. **Creation of the** `application` **within the DigitalHub** `partnership`.

#### 💡 SUMMARY

This endpoint let you obtain the list of document types.
This is necessary to know which specific document type you want to user when you store a new document.

post.description: A document containing multiple versions can be restored to a previous version.

When calling this endpoint, special attention must be paid to the type of document being saved, as the retention rules may depend on it. Initially, it is necessary to distinguish between: * **Document Type**\ This will always be the same: `Documento informatico`. * **Document Category**\ Refers to the `Tipologia documentale` metadata, which being a list, can have different values. The retention rules depend precisely on these values. Below is an excerpt of the JSON provided by the other endpoint [getdocumenttypes](/api-docs?api=ah-documentstorage#tag/document/GET/api/v1/documentstorage/Document/getdocumenttypes) showing the structure described above:

Therefore, in the object passed in the `body` of the call, the following must be specifically included: * **documentTypeId**\ Set this to the ID of the document type `Documento informatico`, which will never change. * **metadata**\ Include, among the metadata, also `Tipologia documentale` and set it to one of the values provided in the `options_list` above (the example shows only one value, but in reality there may be many).\ Additional details on metadata are provided below. * **company**\ This is important as it allows separating documents from one company versus another (based on VAT number - `vatNumber`). This ensures a clear separation of content and allows the DMS to return only the documents of a specific company on request. ## Metadata Metadata should be specified in the form: ```JSON { "name": "{metadata name}", "value": "{metadata value}" } ``` There are various metadata fields available for this document type (you can use the “[getdocumenttypes](/api-docs?api=ah-documentstorage#tag/document/GET/api/v1/documentstorage/Document/getdocumenttypes)” call to consult them); the main ones are: * `Tipologia documentale` (predefined list of values by LeviaHub) \*Required - See the specification above. * `Soggetti – Denominazione` (descriptive name identifying the document) \*Required * `Dati di registrazione - Data registrazione` (document date) \*Required * `Dati di registrazione - Numero documento` (document number) \*Required * `ProductCode` (pass the code associated with your product – see the “Code” field in the table at the beginning of the document) \*Required * `Informazione 1` (free field) * `Informazione 2` (free field) * `Informazione 3` (free field) * `Informazione 4` (free field) * `Informazione 5` (free field) Additionally, we have prepared 3 metadata fields to allow the calling product to save information from its own database within the document: * `TenantCode` * `EntityCode` * `EntityId` Finally, there are many other metadata fields that can be used as needed, which can be consulted via the [getdocumenttypes](/api-docs?api=ah-documentstorage#tag/document/GET/api/v1/documentstorage/Document/getdocumenttypes) call.
Once a document is archived and a specific version is created, it can be retrieved using the document ID and the version number.
